faqs.question: Is City Desk 100% free and open-access?
faqs.answer: Yes. All 1,000 localized trade pages, live customizers, and standalone HTML + Schema.org bundle downloads are 100% free and unlocked by default.

faqs.question: Are there any monthly agency retainers?
faqs.answer: No. Standalone HTML exports run statically on any host without recurring retainers.
